facts.text: The hotel opened on New Year's Eve 1912 as the first Ritz-Carlton in North America.
facts.excerpt: Opened on New Year's Eve 1912, this was the first Ritz-Carlton in North America

facts.text: The hotel is the birthplace of Ritz-Carlton Afternoon Tea.
Afternoon tea has been a tradition in the Palm Court since 1912.
facts.excerpt: The Afternoon Tea experience is a tradition at the iconic Ritz-Carlton Montreal since 1912

facts.text: At Maison Boulud, French cuisine is reinterpreted with local products.
facts.excerpt: At Maison Boulud restaurant, French cuisine is reinterpreted with local products

facts.text: Maison Boulud has a terrace overlooking Sherbrooke Street and a year-round greenhouse with a view of the open kitchen.
facts.excerpt: The fine dining setting includes a terrace overlooking Sherbrooke Street, a year-round greenhouse with a view of the open kitchen

facts.text: The Palm Court lobby has a Dom Pérignon Champagne Bar serving cocktails and afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: the Dom Pérignon Champagne Bar, within the romantic Palm Court lobby, features cocktails and afternoon tea

facts.text: The hotel offers a Glatt Kosher Afternoon Tea made in a kitchen certified Kosher Mehadrin.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a delightful Glatt Kosher Afternoon Tea made in our kitchen certified Kosher Mehadrin

facts.text: The Cosner Art Gallery at the hotel presents Canadian painters to guests.
facts.excerpt: The Cosner Art Gallery at the Ritz-Carlton Montreal presents the great Canadian painters to the guests of the hotel.

facts.text: Spa St. James has waterfalls and fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: Waterfalls, fireplaces, and an indoor saltwater pool overlooking Montreal set the scene at Spa St. James.

facts.text: Suites include fireplaces and separate living spaces.
facts.excerpt: Suites include fireplaces and separate living spaces.

facts.text: Bathrooms have marble, heated floors and rainforest shower heads.
facts.excerpt: Spacious Bathroom: marble, heated floors, rainforest shower heads, TOTO toilet with heated seat

facts.text: The hotel is in the center of the Golden Square Mile, with museums, luxury shopping, nightlife and McGill University within a few blocks.
facts.excerpt: with museums, luxury shopping, nightlife, and McGill University all within mere blocks

facts.text: The certified Kosher kitchen is closed on Fridays.
facts.excerpt: Please note that our certified Kosher Kitchen is closed on Friday.

facts.text: The Glatt Kosher Afternoon Tea requires reservations at least 48 hours in advance.
facts.excerpt: Reservations at least 48 hours in advance.

facts.text: Spa St. James is by appointment only.
Maison Boulud is helmed by 2-Michelin-star Chef Daniel Boulud.

facts.excerpt: More than 110 years and a $200 million renovation later
